display_name: 固定恢复专家的源域频率互补诊断
description: 在已探索源域 pilot 上比较 DURA、联合粒子、残差扩散和固定融合网络的 IQ 误差，并计算依赖 clean IQ 的不可部署频率选择 oracle。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU5 FP32 TF32 off deterministic; 672 source pilot IQ only

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source paired IQ diagnostic only; no F or target and no identity-accuracy claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed frozen DURA, joint, residual diffusion and spectral mixture; no model updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Both 32768-ID parent fits and the gate 17632-ID out-of-parent fit exclude all 672 source pilot IDs; source-only checkpoints
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Three source-only fixed checkpoints with matching legal source roles; pilot disjoint from three new models; DURA may have seen pilot
checkpoint.selection_rule: Analyze all three fixed source models without choosing based on target; privileged clean source IQ oracle is nondeployable and no identity bound

execution.gpu_policy: GPU5: >=8192 MiB free, fewer than 3 total compute apps and at most one this-task worker; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json with source per-view IQ NMSE and per-record better/worse counts; no trained model

metric_names: privileged frequency-oracle error and bin fractions
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; source paired IQ geometry only

rows.method: Fixed three experts and source-trained gate, plus unrealizable nearest-complex-spectrum-per-frequency oracle using source clean IQ
rows.purpose: Source paired-IQ complementarity analysis only; no trained candidate or identity accuracy claim
rows.seed_notes: All three final epoch20 source models frozen from previous registrations; no training, no target selection.
rows.budget_ref: 672 previously explored source IQ pairs; RX4/6 and RX8 x 7 views x 48; two-real-record smoke, batch8

notes: Source-only IQ diagnosis using previously explored 672 pilot; pilot is excluded from three candidate fits but DURA may have seen it.
Oracle uses source clean IQ per frequency; it is not deployable and not an identity-accuracy or arbitrary-network upper bound.
No F weights or outputs, TX labels, V, target IQ, target truth, model updates or target-based model selection.
